objective: Test source-bound semantic insertion metadata as a distinct precursor to reusable trajectory-memory retrieval, without questions or answer-key patterns.
hypothesis: Model-generated insertion metadata over complete before/after text states may capture reusable surface/workflow distinctions that lexical goal/path notes missed. Exact source quotations stay separate from unverified semantic interpretation.

research_sources.finding: The official method separates raw-state, event and note pools and generates semantic procedure/hint notes through a controller. Our r75 lexical path inventory was not equivalent. The official event prompt also uses thoughts and screenshots; this candidate intentionally excludes both, so it is an adaptation, not a reproduction.
research_sources.transfer_limit: Do not transfer official benchmark results or claim native fixed-reader comparability.

research_sources.finding: EvolveMem exposes retrieval configuration to failure diagnosis, guarded updates and development evaluation. Its diagnostic logs include reference answers. This is evidence for a research loop, not permission to expose confirmation answers or import a new authority/engine.
research_sources.decision: Retain immutable candidate versions, predeclared whole-cohort gates and independent confirmation; do not substitute repeated exposed improvement for superiority.

research_sources.finding: SimpleMem distinguishes insertion-time structured memory construction from query-aware retrieval. The repository's evolving memory ideas motivate a distinct source-presentation experiment; its reported gains do not establish ARE quality.

public_source_example_exposure.posture: Public prompt examples encountered during source inspection, not benchmark answer access.
topics: Incident versus Change Request related-search surfaces
public_source_example_exposure.future_confirmation_rule: Screen future confirmation admission for these worked-example subjects; exact overlaps cannot be called untouched. Do not inspect closed confirmation question fields just to map them now.

prospective_pilot.selection: First4 eligible trajectory IDs per domain; first witnessed changed transition whose two whole projected accessibility trees fit22000 UTF8 bytes. Goal at most1500 characters, action at most512. No source clipping, question matching or replacement.
prospective_pilot.admission: Measure all8 prompts before generation; stop unconfirmed transport and never replay. Known-invalid public JSON is retained as failure in denominator, never repaired.
prospective_pilot.output_gate: All8 known-cost outputs validate closed schema, conservative unverified outcome, exact unique before/after quotations bound to source SHA and UTF8 bytes. This permits semantic/source review only, not reader advancement.
prospective_pilot.semantic_boundary: Titles/summaries remain unverified retrieval metadata even when quotations bind correctly. Exact quotation validity does not certify entailment, causal change, task success, completeness of visible UI or answer-bearing reach.
prospective_pilot.followup: Audit semantic usefulness against supplied source without answers. Before any QA reader campaign, construct a reusable index and assess all26 exposed source-reach questions under a distinct frozen protocol; preserve140 closed confirmations.

construction_boundary.authority: Standing owner-approved private G03 research and GLM requests; D65 candidate only.
construction_boundary.product_frontier: Pure metadata validator, question-blind insertion packets and small once-only construction probe.
construction_boundary.operational_lane: Sanitized public trajectory projection and receipts in WSL; existing fixed VPS GLM relay only. No screenshots, model thoughts, credential transfer, new package installation or raw VPS dataset staging.
deferred_residue: Native or explicitly adapted fixed-reader/cost protocol

claim_ceiling: Insertion construction and structural quotation binding only. No new answer accuracy, source-reach pass, official leaderboard result or superiority.
open_questions: Does semantic metadata add useful distinctions beyond already frozen lexical notes?
Are generated summaries grounded and retrieval-useful despite exact quotations?
How should the73 source-capacity-ineligible trajectories be handled without clipping state scopes?
Can all-in insertion/retrieval/reader cost remain competitive?
Which public worked examples must be excluded from future untouched claim cohorts?
